bayts.text: To a Prophet, a Messenger, who came to us with guidance, since he was guided by a Book he brought, and guided (us),
the most lasting greetings, without deceit or turbidity, from the Servant (al-Khadīm) who turns to him as to a refuge.
To his illustrious Family and to all the Companions, from me, a greeting that makes security and ease endure.
O my master, O Messenger of Allah, O my hope, may He bless you Who has driven away whoever rebelled.
O Select One, O leader of all the messengers together, upon you the greeting of Him Who through you has purified the heart.
May He bless you, with a greeting beyond number, Who was never begotten and has not begotten (Qurʾān 112:3).
May an Everlasting One (Al-Bāqī) Who has no partner bless you and grant you peace, together with the Family, O you who drove falsehood away.
May an Everlasting One Who knows no exhaustion bless you and grant you peace, together with the Companions, O you who brought right conduct near.
O people of Medina, from me, for ever, to you the most lasting greeting, which makes heart and body wholesome.
May you ever remain in serenity and abundance; may Allah shield you, until the Gardens, from whoever persists (in rebellion).
You have won that the son of ʿAbd Allāh is your neighbour, and that you are around him: so praise the Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
May He bless him Who ever repels the enemies toward others than whoever turns to him, for ever, as to a refuge.
May a service of my life, accepted from me, gladden him, by the grace of Him Who through him bestowed (guidance) and guided.
